fusions.name: Placid Shove
fusions.desc: A heavy shove with a polyp-crusted flank that deals 4 damage, makes the target [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds and slows it by 25% for 3 seconds. It has a 30% chance to leave the target [Hindered] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Lazy Current
fusions.desc: Pours a cone of slow water that deals 10 damage to everything caught in it, pushes each back 2 tiles and leaves it [Stalled] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Drifting Lagoon
fusions.desc: Raises a calm lagoon where you stand. For 14 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally inside it.

fusions.name: Buoyant Frame
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 10%. You regenerate 0.6 health a second, permanently.
